thread:
olivia: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9876 — implements client-side KV prefix caching + routing fallback. This is gated on the design RFC (019). Need architecture signoff before merge. RFC: https://docs.redwood.com/rfcs/019-kv-cache-routing. Can archs take a look?

sam: quick Q — does this require any migration or a config flip?

olivia: no DB migration. default behavior unchanged. opt-in via config `enable_kv_cache: true`. tests + unit coverage included.

raj: pinging @maya and @kevin for arch review. also, are perf numbers attached?

maya: I'll take a look today. please paste the perf summary and the canary plan here. want to verify failure modes too.

olivia: perf summary: 95th latency ~20% improvement at batch=32 on T4 in our microbench. memory overhead ~6%. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, watch error-rate, p95, and rollout logs. Failure-mode: automatic fallback to stateless route when KV misses or cache errors occur. header `X-Backend: fallback` added on fallback. snippet: ```if (!kv_hit) { route = stateless_variant; }```

kevin: noted. please add a short section in console rollout docs about the header and how to monitor. otherwise looks fine to me pending maya signoff.

maya: taking a look now. I left a few small nits in PR comments (naming + one flaky test). If those are addressed I'll aim to approve by EOD.

olivia: will fix the nits in a follow-up commit and request re-review. ETA ~2h. marking PR as do-not-merge until approved.

archbot: RFC 019 status update: "Under review by Architecture" — reviewers: maya, kevin.

sam: quick ask for release notes copy (one-liner) for release tracker.

olivia: release note: "Added opt-in KV prefix caching with routing fallback to reduce tail latency (config: `enable_kv_cache`)."

kevin: approving in principle; will add final +1 after maya approves. :eyes:

maya: approved after nits addressed. leaving formal signoff in RFC thread and approving PR now. :white_check_mark:

olivia: thanks everyone — merging once CI green and rollout window is open.
